description: This file implements Windows-specific filesystem monitoring for a Git-like system, using ReadDirectoryChangesW to watch directories and handle filesystem events asynchronously.

classes.name: one_watch
classes.description: Represents a directory watch with buffers, handles, and state for asynchronous directory change notifications.

classes.name: fsm_listen_data
classes.description: Holds data related to active directory watches and IPC handles for the listening thread.

methods.name: normalize_path_in_utf8
methods.description: Converts a wide-character path to UTF-8 and normalizes it.

methods.name: check_for_shortnames
methods.description: Checks if the directory has shortnames enabled and stores the shortname for .git if present.

methods.name: get_relative_longname
methods.description: Converts a relative path to a longname, handling shortname conversions and path normalization.

methods.name: fsm_listen__stop_async
methods.description: Signals the listening thread to shut down asynchronously.

methods.name: create_watch
methods.description: Creates a directory watch handle with associated buffers and state.

methods.name: destroy_watch
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a directory watch.

methods.name: start_rdcw_watch
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous ReadDirectoryChangesW watch on a directory.

methods.name: recv_rdcw_watch
methods.description: Retrieves the result of an asynchronous directory change notification.

methods.name: process_1_worktree_event
methods.description: Processes a single filesystem event for the worktree, handling special cases for .git and cookie files.

methods.name: process_worktree_events
methods.description: Processes filesystem events for the main worktree directory, handling overflows and event batching.

methods.name: process_gitdir_events
methods.description: Processes filesystem events for external git directories, focusing on cookie files.

methods.name: fsm_listen__loop
methods.description: Main loop for directory monitoring, handling events, errors, and shutdown signals.

methods.name: fsm_listen__ctor
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the directory monitoring system, setting up watches and IPC handles.

methods.name: fsm_listen__dtor
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources used by the directory monitoring system.
